recipe.name: Sphenodon — the parietal / investment / Silver 925
recipe.calibration_note: Starting shrink allowance; confirm with the caster's alloy, wax and measured trials.

manufacturing.bench_notes: Lost wax. A tuatara lies round the band: its head on the face with a 3.0 mm round peridot set flush in a mound on the crown of the skull, ringed with beads; its crest a serrated fin from the nape to the tail tip. Sprue from the palm. At the bench: drill from the raised dot and cut the flush seat, set the peridot; clean the fin's spines and the toes with a fine graver; polish the ground, leave the skin satin.
